verdict.rationale: Free public startup document generators or downloadable forms are a fair question for a venture-focused law firm, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows Gide drafting financing documentation for clients and using internal legal technology to deliver its own services. Nothing shows free, publicly accessible incorporation documents, SAFEs, term sheets or NDAs available to non-clients.

support.subject: As a founder, I can use the firm's free public document generators or downloadable startup forms — incorporation documents, SAFEs/term sheets, NDAs — without being a client
